items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I got to know Earl and Louie very well and I had a table at the Sunset -- nobody had that table but me after 11:00 o'clock

ctx.x: Yeah --- and the other one was Earl -- got to be famous - he was from Philadelphia. But, anyway, those guys were leaving and they needed trumpet players. So, he said -- you know, you guys want the job, you got it. And, uh, you join us in a 30-day period or something at Castle Farm, Cincinnati. He said, you guys, you're all set to take the job. And, they were a Victor Recording artists and, so, the first--- well, of course, I haven't got there yet, but the first recording with those guys was "I'll Just Be Breezing…
Well, that was the time they hired you for a period in the future.
